parrafo_1.es: Handyman & Landscaping es el equipo de Juan en Kendall: pavimentos, sistemas de riego, jardines y reparaciones generales. Las resenas lo repiten una y otra vez: profesional, puntual y con trabajo de calidad.
parrafo_1.en: Handyman & Landscaping is Juan's crew out of Kendall: pavers, irrigation systems, garden installs and general home repairs. The reviews say it over and over: professional, on time, and quality work.

parrafo_2.es: Desde restaurar pavers y reparar bombas de riego que llevaban anos sin funcionar, hasta renovar pisos interiores: el trabajo queda documentado en su Instagram @jlimongilawnc.
parrafo_2.en: From restoring pavers and fixing irrigation pumps that had not worked in years, to renovating interior flooring: the work is documented on Instagram @jlimongilawnc.

texto.es: Nos cuentas que necesitas (pavers, riego, jardin o reparacion) y coordinamos una visita.
texto.en: Tell us what you need (pavers, irrigation, garden or repair) and we set up a visit.

texto.es: Revisamos el area en persona y te damos un presupuesto claro antes de empezar.
texto.en: We check the area in person and give you a clear quote before starting.

texto.es: Pavers, irrigacion, jardin o reparacion: Juan y su equipo lo resuelven con cuidado y a tiempo.
texto.en: Pavers, irrigation, garden or repair: Juan and his crew handle it with care and on time.

texto.es: Revisamos el resultado contigo y quedamos disponibles si necesitas algo mas despues.
texto.en: We walk the result through with you and stay available if you need anything else after.

nota.es: Cada trabajo se cotiza segun el alcance. Llama o escribe y te damos el detalle sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every job is quoted based on scope. Call or message and we will walk you through it, no strings attached.

texto.es: Instalacion y restauracion de pavers, caminos y patios, como el patio con cesped sintetico y pavers que ves en la galeria.
texto.en: Paver installation and restoration, walkways and patios, like the turf-and-paver patio you see in the gallery.

texto.es: Reparacion de bombas y sistemas de riego que llevan anos sin funcionar, como describen varias resenas reales.
texto.en: Repair of pumps and irrigation systems that have gone years without working, exactly as several real reviews describe.

texto.es: Jardines con mantillo, plantas y palmeras, disenados y plantados para que se vean bien desde el primer dia.
texto.en: Mulch beds, plants and palms, designed and installed to look sharp from day one.

texto.es: De pisos a acabados interiores: el mismo equipo que arregla tu jardin resuelve reparaciones dentro de casa.
texto.en: From flooring to interior finishes: the same crew that fixes your yard handles repairs inside the house too.

pie.es: No ves lo que buscas? Escribenos igual, seguro lo cubrimos.
pie.en: Do not see what you need? Message us anyway, we likely cover it.

items.quote: Juan has done a beautiful job on my landscaping and so many other jobs. Ty Juan for your service and dedication to excellence. Loved his work and highly recommend Juan.

Juan is very professional and knowledgable. He restored our pavers and fixed our irrigation system/pump that hasn't been working for many years. Great job, fast, professional, impecable. Highly recommend!
Great experience with Juan from Handyman & Landscaping Service! He did a really good job, was professional, and arrived right on time. I appreciate the quality of the work and his reliability.
